name: Globed Mobile Voice Chat
description: Adds a movable push-to-talk button for Globed voice chat on Android/iOS. Requires a build of Globed with mobile voice sending enabled -- on a stock Globed install the button will appear but won't transmit audio.

enabled.name: Enable Button
enabled.description: Show the push-to-talk button while connected to a Globed session. Turn off to hide it completely.

edit-position.name: Move Button
edit-position.description: While ON, drag the push-to-talk button anywhere on screen. Turn back OFF to lock it in place and use it normally.
